pools.title: Will the exchange relaunch pass regulatory review?
pools.description: Voided — no filing ever existed, so the market was cancelled and every position refunded at 100% of stake.
pools.resolution: Cancelled by the operator: the underlying process never started.

pools.title: Did Aerodrome flip Uniswap in daily volume this quarter?
pools.description: Settled YES. Aerodrome printed a higher 24h volume than Uniswap on Base for 9 of 90 days, and the rule required the quarterly average.
pools.resolution: Quarterly average daily volume per DeFiLlama: Aerodrome above Uniswap → YES.

pools.title: Will a single weekend cross $1B at the global box office this year?
pools.description: Only three weekends in history have cleared $1B worldwide. The release calendar has one plausible cluster in Q4 and no obvious back-to-back tentpoles.
pools.resolution: Comscore worldwide weekend estimate ≥ $1,000,000,000 → YES.

pools.title: Will the top KOL's 100x call break issue price within a week?
pools.description: The deployer wallet has been splitting exits every six hours into a single market maker's collection address. The community is still posting diamond hands — that usually buys one more leg.
pools.resolution: DEX price below the launch price on any venue within 7 days of the call → YES.

pools.title: Will the FDA approve a CRISPR therapy for a common disease?
pools.description: Sickle-cell was the easy case. A common-disease indication needs durability data across thousands of patients, and only two programmes are that far along.
pools.resolution: FDA approval of a CRISPR-based therapy for an indication affecting ≥1% of the population → YES.

pools.title: Will Starship reach orbit twice within one quarter?
pools.description: Cadence, not capability, is the constraint. Two orbital insertions inside 90 days requires the launch tower and both vehicles to turn around cleanly.
pools.resolution: Two SpaceX flights achieve orbital velocity within a 90-day window → YES.

pools.title: Will a G7 country announce a retail CBDC pilot before July?
pools.description: Wholesale pilots are common, retail pilots are not. Political cost dominates: only two G7 central banks have legislation in place.
pools.resolution: Central bank or finance ministry announces a retail-facing CBDC pilot with real users → YES.

pools.title: Will the EU pass its AI Act enforcement package this quarter?
pools.description: Trilogue negotiations have stalled twice on the general-purpose model annex. Council and Parliament both want a deal before the summer recess.
pools.resolution: Official EU Journal publication of the enforcement implementing act → YES.

pools.title: Will the US avoid a government shutdown past December 20?
pools.description: A continuing resolution is on the table and both chambers have signalled they want to avoid a holiday shutdown. The tail risk is a single-issue amendment fight.
pools.resolution: No lapse in appropriations between Dec 20 and Jan 5 (OPM status unchanged) → YES.

pools.title: Will the US 10-year yield close above 5% before year end?
pools.description: Term premium has been climbing but the 5% level has rejected three times this year. A hot CPI print plus a weak auction could do it in a week.
pools.resolution: CNBC/FRED daily close of the 10Y yield ≥ 5.00% on any trading day before Dec 31 → YES.

pools.title: Will US CPI year-over-year print below 2.5% in November?
pools.description: Shelter disinflation is finally in the print and goods are already deflationary. Tariff pass-through, however, has not hit the index yet.
pools.resolution: BLS CPI release for November shows headline YoY < 2.50% → YES.

pools.title: Will the Fed cut rates by 25bp at the December meeting?
pools.description: Core PCE has printed below target for two consecutive months. The dot plot still implies a hold, which is exactly the gap this market is pricing.
pools.resolution: FOMC statement announces a 25bp cut to the target range at the December meeting → YES.

pools.title: Will an open-weight model top the LMSYS leaderboard?
pools.description: Open weights have been within 20 Elo of the frontier for four months. One more distillation cycle could close it — or a closed-model refresh could reopen the gap.
pools.resolution: LMSYS Chatbot Arena overall rank #1 held by a model with downloadable weights for 7 consecutive days → YES.

pools.title: Will a humanoid robot work a paid shift in a commercial factory this year?
pools.description: Pilots are everywhere; paid production shifts are not. The bar here is a documented, customer-billed deployment with published throughput numbers — not a stage demo.
pools.resolution: A named manufacturer publicly confirms a humanoid robot on a billed production line with throughput data → YES.

pools.title: Will an autonomous agent finish top-10% in a public trading contest by Q2?
pools.description: Contest must have at least 1,000 human participants and a public leaderboard. Three agent teams already beat the median human desk in last month's invite-only arena.
pools.resolution: Any agent-run account in the top 10% of a public contest with ≥1,000 participants, verified by the organiser → YES.

pools.title: Will GPT-6 ship before July 2026?
pools.description: Inference payment contracts are up 240% quarter over quarter — a new model is already running in the grey. But frontier capex is committed through 2027 and the last two flagship releases slipped a full quarter each.
pools.resolution: An official OpenAI model card or API endpoint named 'gpt-6' published before 2026-07-01 00:00 UTC → YES.

pools.title: Will Solana flip BNB Chain in monthly DEX volume?
pools.description: DeFiLlama monthly DEX volume, all chains, calendar month. Solana has closed the gap to under 8% twice this quarter but has not printed a clean flip since the memecoin cycle peak.
pools.resolution: DeFiLlama 'DEX Volume' ranking for the calendar month shows Solana above BNB Chain → YES.

pools.title: Will ETH/BTC reclaim 0.04 before year end?
pools.description: ETH/BTC has compressed for nine months. Staking yields are flat, but L2 fee burn and ETF flow rotation both argue for a catch-up trade. The ratio needs roughly +14% from here to clear the strike.
pools.resolution: Binance ETH/BTC daily close ≥ 0.0400 on any day before 23:59 UTC on Dec 31 → YES.

pools.title: Will Base break 5M daily active addresses this week?
pools.description: Measured on the 7-day rolling average of daily active addresses reported by L2Beat and the official Base dashboard. Three consumer apps crossed 1M weekly actives this month and gas has stayed sub-cent through the entire run.
pools.resolution: L2Beat + Base dashboard agree on ≥ 5,000,000 daily active addresses for any single day inside the window → YES.

pools.title: Will Bitcoin close above $120,000 this week?
pools.description: Weekly close reference is the Binance BTC/USDT 1W candle. The market resolves YES if the weekly candle closes at or above $120,000.00. Spot ETF net inflows have run 3.1x weekly issuance for three straight weeks while perp funding sits at 41% annualised — positioning is the whole story here.
pools.resolution: Binance BTC/USDT weekly candle close ≥ $120,000.00 → YES. Exchange outages longer than 30 minutes at the close push resolution to the next available candle.
